name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person across every site, pen and tank, worst first. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Legal duties, consent limits and fish welfare
sections.note: Unreported mortality events, feed caps, stocking density and low oxygen.
sections.sql: select coalesce(site, '') as site, item, rule, detail, days from site_attention where severity = 1 order by days desc nulls last, site

sections.title: Overdue and close
sections.sql: select coalesce(site, '') as site, item, rule, detail, days from site_attention where severity = 2 order by days desc nulls last, site

sections.title: Housekeeping
sections.sql: select coalesce(site, '') as site, item, rule, detail, days from site_attention where severity = 3 order by days desc nulls last, site

name: stock
title: Stock in the water
subtitle: Every stocked pen and tank: fish, average weight, biomass and density against its limit.

sections.title: By site
sections.sql: select site, count(*)::int as units, sum(count)::int as fish, round(sum(biomass_kg) / 1000.0, 1)::float as biomass_t from holding_now group by site order by site

sections.title: By unit
sections.sql: select site, unit, batch, species, count as fish, round(avg_g)::int as avg_g, weighed_on, biomass_kg::float as biomass_kg, density_kg_m3::float as density, max_density_kg_m3::float as limit_kg_m3 from holding_now order by site, unit

name: harvest
title: Harvest plan
subtitle: Units within 10% of harvest weight, and any withholding period that still blocks them.

sections.title: Ready or close
sections.sql: select site, unit, batch, count as fish, round(avg_g)::int as avg_g, target_weight_g::int as target_g, biomass_kg::float as biomass_kg, case when withhold_until >= current_date then 'withholding until ' || withhold_until when avg_g >= target_weight_g then 'ready' else 'growing' end as status from holding_now where avg_g >= target_weight_g * 0.9 order by avg_g desc

sections.title: Harvested in the last 90 days
sections.sql: select x.code, u.code as unit, x.harvested_on, x.count as fish, x.total_kg::float as total_kg, x.processor, x.docket from harvests x join holdings h on h.id = x.holding_id join units u on u.id = h.unit_id where x.harvested_on >= current_date - 90 order by x.harvested_on desc

name: feed
title: Feed
subtitle: Feed against each consent's yearly cap, and the feed on hand.

sections.title: Against the cap, last 365 days
sections.sql: select site, name, feed_t_365d::float as feed_t_365d, feed_cap_t::float as cap_t, pct_of_cap::float as pct_of_cap from site_feed order by pct_of_cap desc nulls last

sections.title: Feed on hand
sections.sql: select code, name, on_hand_kg::float as on_hand_kg, daily_kg_14d::float as daily_kg, days_left, reorder_days from feed_stock order by days_left nulls last
